assets.name: 低矮草丛
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent 2D roadside scenery cutout for a forward-running Godot game.
Input image 1 (game forest map) is the primary hand-drawn scenery shape, brush language and cool dark palette reference; image 2 (earlier mushroom asset) supplies only the surrounding foliage/rock palette, not the mushroom subject; image 3 (latest monster) is a FLAT matte fill and colored contour reference, not a character to reproduce.
Primary request: one low compact connected grass tuft cluster with three soft fan-shaped clumps of long curved tapered blades. Broad readable leaves, dark teal blades with a few desaturated blue-green front blades. An irregular organic bottom silhouette formed by overlapping small leaves, without a soil slab or straight cut.
Style: clean FLAT hand-drawn storybook game illustration matching the previous mushroom forest. Confident slightly organic tapering colored contour lines, broad brush-shaped solid matte color areas, at most one or two flat shadow planes. Restrained medium-value shapes that read against the dark navy forest. No glossy lighting gradients, oily rendering, reflections, granular paint texture, noise or stippling. Do NOT use black outlines.
Palette: desaturated dark petrol teal #41797C, blue-gray #597D91, muted gray violet #85859F, small gray eucalyptus highlights #95B5B4; colored medium gray teal #41636E contours. Avoid saturated emerald, cyan or neon colors.
Composition: ONE coherent isolated scenery asset, front/slight three-quarter view like the reference foreground plants. Centered on 1536x1024 canvas, full silhouette with at least 10% truly transparent margin on ALL sides. Every leaf tip and organic base must finish naturally with no straight cropped bottom or cut-off branches. No cast ground shadow, floor plane, grass island slab or painted background.
Only the requested plant asset. No mushrooms, flowers, characters, faces, eyes, animals, rocks, labels, roads, checker pattern, frame, particles, glow, fog or extra objects. Genuine transparent-background RGBA PNG.
